en.headline: Woman in 60s dies after being pulled from sea off Tsuen Wan
en.dek: Marine police rescued the unconscious woman about 20 metres from shore near Belvedere Garden around midnight; she was certified dead at Yan Chai Hospital after prolonged resuscitation.
body: A woman in her 60s died after being rescued from the sea off Tsuen Wan early on Friday morning.

Police received a report around midnight that a woman was seen floating in the water about 20 metres from shore near Belvedere Garden on Castle Peak Road. Marine police rescued the unconscious woman and brought her ashore.

Paramedics performed emergency treatment and used an automated CPR machine during the journey to Yan Chai Hospital, where she later died. Officers recovered a handbag believed to belong to the woman at the scene.
Investigations into her identity and the circumstances of the incident are continuing.

zh.headline: 荃灣海面救起60多歲女子 送院後不治
zh.dek: 水警於周五凌晨在麗城花園對開約20米海面救起昏迷女子，送仁濟醫院搶救後證實死亡。
body: 一名60多歲女子周五凌晨在荃灣海面被救起後不治。
警方於午夜前後接獲市民報案，指青山公路荃灣段麗城花園對開、距離岸邊約20米的海面有女子載浮載沉。水警到場將已失去知覺的女子救起。
救護人員即場急救，並在送往仁濟醫院途中使用自動心肺復甦機，惜最終證實死亡。警員在現場檢獲一個相信屬於事主的手袋。
警方正調查事主身份及事件經過。
